'''Winsafra Battle Droids Never Die, They Just Slow Down Eventually''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 27 February 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion Winsafra DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Why Waste Em? Plop em on the Flagship an forfeit 'em every turn :P

== Strategy ==

Basically, get captain dolfine out first turn, no matter what! Once you have some battle droids aboard the flagship, then worry about the ground. Space is much more precarious in this deck, so make sure you plop as many battle droid pilots as you can on the flagship :P

Next, secure the throne room, the only deck that'll make this difficult is a We Have a Plan deck, or possibly lightsaber combat. if your playing against we have a plan, get the throne room fast to keep em from flipping, try for first turn, cause its really really easy to flip we have a plan first turn, and a pain in the arse to get it flipped back.

Good Luck! an thanks for reading :)
